$provenance: Generated by the canonical Dart implementation, not by hand and not by the TypeScript port: crux_cxp's cxpDesignIdForPath (crux-shared/packages/crux_cxp/lib/src/cxp_design_id.dart) was run over every `lexical` input in corpus.json and its 16-hex tokens recorded verbatim. src/cxp/design-id.ts is asserted against these, which is what makes 'the two derivations agree' a measurement rather than a claim. To regenerate: `echo '<the lexical inputs as a JSON array>' | dart run --packages=<crux-shared>/.dart_tool/package_config.json tool/dart-conformance/design_id_tokens.dart`, then map input -> name. A value that changes here is a WIRE-VISIBLE change: every peer keying the same folder differently stops joining, so a regeneration is a deliberate act that needs the Dart side changed in the same breath.
$platformNote: These tokens are POSIX-shaped. Under the Windows path style `p.normalize` rewrites the separators and `p.canonicalize` lowercases, so the same inputs produce different (equally correct) tokens there; the test skips this block when `path.sep` is not '/', and the live cross-run against the Dart implementation is what covers Windows.
$sanityCheck: root-file is the sha256 of the single character '/', truncated to 16 hex — 8a5edab282632443. If that one drifts, the digest step drifted, not the path step.
